title: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory under QCO 2025

amendments.summary: Mandatory QCO enforcement; BIS certification under IS 2082:2018 is required, with IS 302 Part 2/Sec 21 safety requirements deemed complied with.

characteristics: Stationary pressurized water storage vessel (up to 0.8 MPa operating pressure)
Mineral insulated electric heating element (1 kW to 6 kW)
Automatic adjustable thermostat and non-self-resetting thermal cut-out
Pressure relief safety valve and vacuum relief valve
intended_use: Safe domestic heating and pressurized storage of potable water for sanitary purposes
Residential and commercial bathroom and kitchen hot water supply

key_clauses.title: Protection Against Access to Live Electrical Components
key_clauses.requirement_text: Enclosure and terminal covers must prevent contact with live electrical parts using test probe B under 20 N force. Earthing continuity must be lower than 0.1 ohm.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard IEC test finger probe B insertion and earthing milliohm resistance check
key_clauses.required_evidence: Electrical Safety & Earthing Continuity Test Report

key_clauses.title: Leakage Current and Dielectric High Voltage Strength at Operating Temperature
key_clauses.requirement_text: At operating water temperature, leakage current must not exceed 0.75 mA for Class I appliances. Dielectric strength must withstand 1250V AC for 60 seconds without flashover.
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated leakage current transducer and 1250V AC high voltage hipot tester
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL High Voltage Dielectric Strength & Leakage Log Report

key_clauses.title: Abnormal Operation and Boil-Dry Protection
key_clauses.requirement_text: When energised without water in tank (boil-dry condition), the thermal cut-out must trip safely without flame, molten metal emission, or tank rupture.
key_clauses.test_method: Simulated dry-run energized burn test with thermal sensors at 1.15 rated power
key_clauses.required_evidence: Abnormal Dry Boiling Safety Trip Test Report

key_clauses.title: Pressure Vessel Hydrostatic Strength & Pressure Relief Valve Operation
key_clauses.requirement_text: Tank must withstand 1.5 times rated working pressure (min 1.2 MPa for a 0.8 MPa tank) for 15 minutes with zero water leak, seam rupture, or permanent deformation. Pressure relief valve must open at rated limit.
key_clauses.test_method: Hydrostatic test bench with calibrated hydraulic gauge and leak detector
key_clauses.required_evidence: Hydrostatic Pressure Test Certificate & Relief Valve Calibration Log

key_clauses.title: Component Endurance for Thermostat and Thermal Cut-Out
key_clauses.requirement_text: Thermostatic controller must complete 10,000 switching cycles and thermal cut-out 1,000 cycles under electrical load without contact welding or calibration drift greater than 3°C.
key_clauses.test_method: Automated electrical endurance test rig cycling at 6 operations per minute
key_clauses.required_evidence: Thermostatic Switch Endurance Cycle Test Report

title: Textiles – Bedsheets, Pillow Cover and Blanket Cover - Specification
status: Current / High Consumer Quality
characteristics: 100% woven cotton, polyester-cotton blend, or regenerated cellulosic fiber
Prescribed minimum thread count, yarn count, and grams per square meter (GSM)
Skin-contact friendly with strict pH control and absence of hazardous azo colorants
Color fastness against perspiration, rubbing, and industrial laundering
intended_use: Domestic bedding, institutional hospital linens, hospitality and hotel bedding
Direct human skin contact during sleep and rest

key_clauses.title: pH Value of Aqueous Extract for Skin Safety
key_clauses.requirement_text: The pH value of aqueous extract of bedsheet fabric shall be strictly between 5.5 and 7.5 to prevent dermatological skin irritation and allergic reactions.
key_clauses.test_method: Aqueous extraction pH potentiometric determination conforming to IS 1390
key_clauses.required_evidence: Aqueous Extract pH Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Colour Fastness to Washing, Perspiration and Rubbing
key_clauses.requirement_text: Color fastness to domestic washing (IS 687) minimum rating 4, perspiration (IS 971) minimum rating 4, and dry rubbing minimum rating 4 on ISO Grey Scale.
key_clauses.test_method: Launder-Ometer wash cycle and Crockmeter rubbing fastness test
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Color Fastness Grey Scale Evaluation Report

key_clauses.title: Dimensional Stability (Shrinkage Limits on Washing)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Maximum allowable shrinkage after 3 cycles of standard laundering shall not exceed 3.0% in warp and 2.0% in weft direction for cotton fabric.
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated washing shrinkage template measuring bench under IS 2977
key_clauses.required_evidence: Dimensional Stability Wash Shrinkage Log

key_clauses.title: Antimicrobial Activity and Freedom from Banned Azo Dyes
key_clauses.requirement_text: Total prohibited aromatic amine dyes (carcinogenic azo dyes) must not exceed 20 mg/kg. Antibacterial efficacy (>90% reduction) if claimed as treated bed linen.
key_clauses.test_method: GC-MS spectrometry extraction conforming to IS 15570
key_clauses.required_evidence: Chemical Spectrometry Azo-Free Test Certificate

title: Medical Electrical Equipment - Basic Safety & Essential Performance of Automated Non-Invasive Sphygmomanometers
status: Current / Very High Medical Safety Relevance
characteristics: Inflatable brachial/wrist cuff with electric pump and controlled release solenoid
Oscillometric digital pressure transducer with systolic, diastolic, and heart rate computation
Type BF applied part with patient electrical isolation
Dual mechanical and software overpressure limiters
intended_use: Clinical and domestic non-invasive diagnostic monitoring of human arterial blood pressure
Hypertension tracking in hospitals, clinics, and home health care

key_clauses.title: Maximum Permissible Error of Cuff Pressure Indication
key_clauses.requirement_text: For both increasing and decreasing pressure across the measurement range (0 to 260 mmHg), the error in cuff pressure indication shall not exceed ±3 mmHg (±0.4 kPa).
key_clauses.test_method: Comparison against calibrated digital mercury-free reference manometer
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Certified Pressure Metrology Calibration Certificate

key_clauses.title: Clinical Investigation and Overall Blood Pressure Determination Accuracy
key_clauses.requirement_text: Clinical determination validation across 85 subjects: mean difference between automated device and auscultatory reference shall not exceed ±5 mmHg with standard deviation <= 8 mmHg.
key_clauses.test_method: ISO 81060-2 clinical validation protocol with dual-observer auscultation
key_clauses.required_evidence: Clinical Accuracy Evaluation & Subject Validation Dossier

key_clauses.title: Patient Electrical Leakage Current and Dielectric Isolation (Type BF)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Patient leakage current from cuff to ground under single fault condition must not exceed 500 uA AC / 50 uA DC. Dielectric insulation must withstand 1500V AC test voltage.
key_clauses.test_method: Medical electrical safety analyzer test conforming to IS 13450 / IEC 60601-1
key_clauses.required_evidence: Medical Electrical Safety & Patient Leakage Test Report

key_clauses.title: Overpressure Safety Cut-Off Protection
key_clauses.requirement_text: The equipment shall incorporate independent secondary overpressure protection that immediately vents the cuff to ambient if pressure exceeds 300 mmHg (adult) or 150 mmHg (neonatal).
key_clauses.test_method: Simulated pneumatic pump runaway test measuring instantaneous venting time (< 1s)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Overpressure Pneumatic Safety Venting Log

title: Coated Paper and Board (Art and Chromo) - Specification
status: Current / Quality Specification
characteristics: High chemical bleached wood pulp base sheet with mineral pigment coating (clay/calcium carbonate)
Uniform surface smoothness, opacity, and gloss suitable for multi-colour halftone printing
Grammage range from 70 g/m² to 350 g/m²
intended_use: High-definition commercial printing, art books, annual reports, calendars, and premium carton packaging

key_clauses.title: Grammage (Mass per Unit Area) and Thickness Tolerances
key_clauses.requirement_text: Grammage tolerance shall not deviate by more than ±2.5% from declared nominal g/m². Caliper thickness must be uniform across web width.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard gravimetric area balance test under IS 1060 (Part 1)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Grammage and Caliper Uniformity Inspection Sheet

key_clauses.title: Surface Smoothness (Bekk / Bendtsen Method)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Gloss art paper must have minimum Bekk smoothness of 600 seconds on wire side and 800 seconds on felt side to ensure dot fidelity without pinholing.
key_clauses.test_method: Bekk air-leak smoothness tester under IS 1060
key_clauses.required_evidence: Surface Smoothness & Porosity Test Log

key_clauses.title: Brightness (ISO) and Diffuse Opacity
key_clauses.requirement_text: ISO brightness shall be minimum 88.0% for Grade 1 art paper. Opacity must be minimum 92.0% for 130 g/m² sheet to prevent show-through.
key_clauses.test_method: Diffuse blue reflectance photometer at 457 nm under ISO 2470
key_clauses.required_evidence: Spectrophotometric Brightness & Opacity Certificate

key_clauses.title: Surface Pick Strength (Dennison Wax / IGT)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Minimum Dennison wax pick rating shall be 10A without surface coating rupture or fibre lifting under high tack printing inks.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard Dennison wax pick kit and IGT printability oil test
key_clauses.required_evidence: Surface Pick Resistance Test Sheet

title: Crop Protection Equipment – Foot Sprayer - Specification
status: Current / High Agricultural Safety Relevance
characteristics: Pedal operated reciprocating plunger pump mounted on steady base frame
Corrosion-resistant brass or stainless steel hydraulic pressure vessel
Suction hose with strainer and discharge hose with cut-off lance and brass nozzle
Operating pressure capability from 0.6 MPa to 1.4 MPa
intended_use: Spraying chemical insecticides, pesticides, and liquid agrochemicals in orchards, field crops, and tea plantations

key_clauses.title: Corrosion Resistance of Chemical Contact Components
key_clauses.requirement_text: Pump cylinder, valve balls, seats, and pressure vessel must be fabricated from brass Grade CW604N or austenitic stainless steel SS 304 resistant to agrochemicals.
key_clauses.test_method: Chemical immersion in pesticide solution for 72 hours and microscopic corrosion check
key_clauses.required_evidence: Material Spectrometry & Chemical Immersion Test Report

key_clauses.title: Hydrostatic Proof Pressure Test of Pressure Chamber
key_clauses.requirement_text: The pressure vessel must withstand internal hydraulic pressure of 2.0 MPa for 5 minutes without any leakage, permanent deformation, or weld failure.
key_clauses.test_method: Hydraulic pressure pump bench with calibrated master gauge
key_clauses.required_evidence: Hydrostatic Proof Pressure Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Discharge Capacity and Spray Cone Angle
key_clauses.requirement_text: At 40 pedal strokes per minute, liquid discharge shall be minimum 1200 ml/min at 0.7 MPa pressure. Nozzle spray cone angle must be 60° ± 5°.
key_clauses.test_method: Flow collection volumetric beaker test with spray pattern laser scanner
key_clauses.required_evidence: Volumetric Discharge Flow Rate Calibration Report

key_clauses.title: Fatigue Endurance Cycling Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: The complete sprayer assembly must complete 100,000 continuous pedal strokes at rated pressure with liquid agrochemical without valve failure or pump leakage.
key_clauses.test_method: Automated pneumatic mechanical pedal cycling machine
key_clauses.required_evidence: 100,000 Cycle Endurance Test Report

title: Domestic Pressure Cookers - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory QCO 2020 / Extremely High Safety

amendments.summary: Mandatory QCO enforcement by DPIIT. Mandatory ISI mark required before sale, import, or distribution in India.

characteristics: Heavy gauge food-grade wrought aluminium alloy (IS 21) or SS 304 austenitic steel (IS 6911)
Steam pressure cooking lid with silicone sealing gasket and locking lugs
Weight-type pressure regulating vent weight (operating at 100 kPa)
Fusible safety relief plug and secondary gasket release safety mechanism
intended_use: Rapid steam pressure boiling and cooking of domestic food items in households

key_clauses.title: Food Contact Raw Material Compliance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Aluminium body must be min 99.0% pure conforming to IS 21 or stainless steel SS 304 conforming to IS 6911. Lead extraction must be below 0.01 mg/kg under IS 9845.
key_clauses.test_method: Optical emission spectrometry and acid extraction food simulant test
key_clauses.required_evidence: Raw Material MTC & Heavy Metal Migration Test Report

key_clauses.title: Operating Pressure Regulation
key_clauses.requirement_text: The normal operating steam pressure regulated by weight valve must be between 90 kPa and 110 kPa (approximately 1.0 kgf/cm²).
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated digital steam pressure transducer recorder during boiling test
key_clauses.required_evidence: Operating Pressure Venting Log Sheet

key_clauses.title: Hydrostatic Bursting Pressure Test (Anti-Explosion Hazard)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Cooker must withstand hydrostatic pressure of not less than 3 times normal operating pressure (min 300 kPa) without body rupture or lid detachment.
key_clauses.test_method: Water hydrostatic bursting rig with high-pressure pump until 300 kPa hold for 5 min
key_clauses.required_evidence: Hydrostatic Bursting Safety Test Report

key_clauses.title: Secondary Safety Device Operation (Fusible Plug / Gasket Release)
key_clauses.requirement_text: If vent pipe is blocked, secondary safety device (fusible plug or gasket release) must release internal pressure safely between 130 kPa and 200 kPa without projectile hazard.
key_clauses.test_method: Deliberate vent blockage overpressurization test bench
key_clauses.required_evidence: Secondary Pressure Relief Device Discharge Certificate

key_clauses.title: Lid-Opening Safety Lock Mechanism
key_clauses.requirement_text: The cooker design must prevent user from opening lid whenever internal residual pressure exceeds 4 kPa, avoiding scalding steam expulsion.
key_clauses.test_method: Residual pressure torque gauge opening resistance test
key_clauses.required_evidence: Lid Interlock Residual Pressure Safety Evaluation

title: Drinking Water - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory Public Health Standard

amendments.summary: Revised maximum permissible limits for pesticides and toxic polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons.

characteristics: Clear, colourless, odourless, palatable water free from pathogenic bacteria and viruses
Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) acceptable limit 500 mg/L (permissible up to 2000 mg/L in absence of alternate source)
Strict zero-tolerance for heavy metals (Arsenic, Lead, Mercury, Chromium)
intended_use: Human consumption, cooking, food preparation, and municipal public drinking water systems

key_clauses.title: Organoleptic and Physical Parameters
key_clauses.requirement_text: Colour max 5 Hazen units, Odour agreeable, Turbidity max 1 NTU, pH value 6.5 to 8.5, Total Dissolved Solids max 500 mg/L.
key_clauses.test_method: Nephelometric turbidity meter, pH meter, and gravimetric TDS oven drying
key_clauses.required_evidence: Comprehensive Physical Parameters Water Test Report

key_clauses.title: Toxic Heavy Metal Concentration Limits
key_clauses.requirement_text: Arsenic max 0.01 mg/L, Lead max 0.01 mg/L, Cadmium max 0.003 mg/L, Total Chromium max 0.05 mg/L, Mercury max 0.001 mg/L.
key_clauses.test_method: Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS) under IS 3025
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL ICP-MS Heavy Metal Spectrometry Analysis Report

key_clauses.title: Microbiological Quality (Bacteriological Criteria)
key_clauses.requirement_text: E. coli and Total Coliform bacteria must be completely absent (zero count) in any 100 ml sample examined.
key_clauses.test_method: Membrane filtration method or multiple tube fermentation under IS 1622
key_clauses.required_evidence: Microbiological Colony Count Zero Detection Certificate

key_clauses.title: Residual Free Chlorine Disinfection Limit
key_clauses.requirement_text: Minimum residual free chlorine of 0.2 mg/L must be present at consumer tap to guarantee ongoing biological disinfection (max 1.0 mg/L).
key_clauses.test_method: DPD colorimetric titrimetric determination under IS 3025 (Part 26)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Residual Chlorine Disinfection Monitoring Log

title: Annatto Colour for Food Products - Specification
status: Current / High Food Safety Relevance
characteristics: Natural carotenoid dye prepared from the pericarp of Bixa orellana L. seeds
Available as oil-soluble bixin solution or water-soluble norbixin alkaline formulation
Strict freedom from coal-tar synthetic dyes and toxic heavy metals
intended_use: Direct natural yellow-to-orange coloring agent in butter, cheese, confectionery, snacks, and edible oils

key_clauses.title: Total Carotenoid Pigment Content (Bixin / Norbixin)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Total carotenoid content calculated as bixin shall not be less than 1.0% by mass in oil-soluble extract and 2.5% norbixin in water-soluble extract.
key_clauses.test_method: UV-Visible spectrophotometric absorbance assay at 487 nm
key_clauses.required_evidence: Spectrophotometric Carotenoid Content Certificate

key_clauses.title: Heavy Metal Impurities (Lead, Arsenic, Mercury)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Lead not more than 2.0 mg/kg, Arsenic not more than 1.0 mg/kg, Mercury not more than 1.0 mg/kg.
key_clauses.test_method: Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometry (AAS)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Heavy Metal Trace Impurity Analysis Report

key_clauses.title: Absence of Synthetic Coal-Tar Dyes
key_clauses.requirement_text: The product must be completely free from extraneous synthetic coal-tar food colours (tartrazine, sunset yellow, metanil yellow).
key_clauses.test_method: High Performance Thin Layer Chromatography (HPTLC) / HPLC
key_clauses.required_evidence: HPLC Chromatography Synthetic Dye Absence Certificate

title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory Road Transport QCO / Critical Life Safety

amendments.summary: Mandatory QCO enforcement; strict maximum weight limit reduced to 1500g and mandatory BIS ISI certification.

characteristics: Rigid outer shell molded from virgin impact-grade ABS / polycarbonate / composite fibers
Protective expanded polystyrene (EPS) shock-absorbing liner of high density
Comfort interior padding, retention chinstrap with micrometric / D-ring fastener
Maximum total helmet weight shall not exceed 1500 grams
intended_use: Head injury mitigation and shock absorption for operators and pillion riders of two-wheel motor vehicles

key_clauses.title: Helmet Shell Construction and Maximum Mass
key_clauses.requirement_text: Outer shell must be smooth, free from dangerous sharp projections, and total helmet mass including all accessories shall not exceed 1500 grams.
key_clauses.test_method: Precision gravimetric balance and surface profile inspection
key_clauses.required_evidence: Mass Verification & Shell Construction Inspection Sheet

key_clauses.title: Impact Absorption Attenuation Test (Head Injury Criterion)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Helmet subjected to guided drop impact on flat and hemispherical steel anvils at 7.5 m/s velocity must transmit peak deceleration <= 300g to instrumented headform.
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated triaxial accelerometer drop test apparatus conditioned at -10°C, +50°C, and water spray
key_clauses.required_evidence: Drop Impact Shock Attenuation Oscillograph Test Report

key_clauses.title: Retention System Dynamic Strength and Slippage Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: Chinstrap under dynamic drop weight of 10 kg from 750 mm height must not stretch more than 25 mm, and buckle must release under 100 N manual force after test.
key_clauses.test_method: Dynamic tensile drop test rig on simulated jaw fixture
key_clauses.required_evidence: Retention Chinstrap Dynamic Tensile Test Report

key_clauses.title: Penetration Resistance Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: A 3.0 kg conical steel striker dropped from 3.0 meters onto the shell must not make electrical contact with the metallic headform inside.
key_clauses.test_method: Guided vertical penetration tube and electrical contact circuit sensor
key_clauses.required_evidence: Shell Penetration Resistance Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Visor Optical Quality and Luminous Transmittance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Clear transparent visor must have luminous transmittance >= 85%, zero optical distortion, and withstand scratch abrasion test without haze > 10%.
key_clauses.test_method: Spectrophotometer transmission bench and Taber abrasion tester
key_clauses.required_evidence: Visor Optical Clarity & Transmittance Test Certificate

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Particular Requirements for Washing Machines
status: Current / Mandatory QCO 2024 / High Consumer Safety
characteristics: Motorized wash agitator/pulsator/drum with water filling valves and drain pump
High-speed spin centrifugal water extraction basket (> 800 RPM)
IPX4 water splash-proof electrical enclosure rating
Electromechanical door/lid interlock preventing access during spin
intended_use: Washing and centrifugal spin-drying of domestic clothes, garments, and home textiles

key_clauses.title: Protection Against Access to Live Parts
key_clauses.requirement_text: Accessible surfaces, motor compartments, and drain valves must prevent accidental contact with live electrical wiring even when user reaches underneath.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard IEC unjointed test probe and rigid test finger
key_clauses.required_evidence: Electrical Ingress & Live Part Safety Inspection Sheet

key_clauses.title: Moisture Resistance & Water Spillage Test (IPX4)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Appliance subjected to 0.5 L water overflow on top lid and oscillating spray nozzle IPX4 test for 10 minutes must show zero insulation breakdown (dielectric 1250V).
key_clauses.test_method: IPX4 oscillating spray water chamber followed by high voltage test
key_clauses.required_evidence: IPX4 Water Ingress & Post-Spray Insulation Test Report

key_clauses.title: Spin Lid Safety Interlock and Braking Time
key_clauses.requirement_text: When the lid or door of spin extraction drum is opened, drive power must automatically cut off and drum must brake to complete stop within 4 seconds.
key_clauses.test_method: Optical tachometer stop-time recorder triggered by lid microswitch
key_clauses.required_evidence: Spin Drum Brake Stop-Time Calibration Certificate

key_clauses.title: Water Hose Pressure and Flooding Resistance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Inlet water hoses must withstand 1.0 MPa hydrostatic pressure for 10 minutes without bursting or connection slip.
key_clauses.test_method: Hydraulic water hose pressure burst bench
key_clauses.required_evidence: Hose Hydrostatic Pressure Burst Log

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – General Safety Requirements
status: Current / Mandatory Base Safety Standard
superseded_status: Active (Core Reference for all Part 2 Standards)
characteristics: Overarching horizontal safety standard for domestic single-phase appliances up to 250V
Class I (earthed), Class II (double insulated), and Class III (SELV) specifications
Clearance and creepage distances, flame-retardant plastic housings, thermal cutoff
intended_use: Comprehensive baseline safety conformity for all household and commercial electrical appliances

key_clauses.title: Protection Against Electric Shock
key_clauses.requirement_text: Adequate protection against contact with live parts under normal use, including during user servicing, bulb replacement, and filter cleaning.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard articulated test probe B and test pin under 10 N force
key_clauses.required_evidence: Baseline Shock Protection Verification Report

key_clauses.title: Heating and Temperature Rise Limits
key_clauses.requirement_text: During normal continuous operation, temperature rise of external operating handles must not exceed 35K (metal) / 50K (plastic); motor windings must not exceed insulation thermal class.
key_clauses.test_method: Multi-channel thermocouple data logger during continuous duty run
key_clauses.required_evidence: Temperature Rise Thermal Mapping Test Report

key_clauses.title: Dielectric High-Voltage Strength and Leakage Current
key_clauses.requirement_text: Insulation must withstand 1000V AC (Class I) / 2500V AC (Class II) for 1 minute without puncture. Leakage current must remain below 0.75 mA.
key_clauses.test_method: High-voltage breakdown tester and leakage current millivoltmeter
key_clauses.required_evidence: Hipot Dielectric Flashover & Leakage Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Resistance to Fire, Glowing Heat and Tracking (Glow-Wire Test)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Non-metallic insulating materials supporting live connections must resist glow-wire test at 750°C (unattended appliances 850°C) with flames extinguishing within 30 seconds.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard glow-wire flammability test apparatus under IEC 60695-2-11
key_clauses.required_evidence: Glow-Wire Flammability & Fire Resistance Report

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Particular Requirements for Electric Irons
status: Current / Mandatory QCO 2024 / High Safety Relevance
characteristics: Die-cast aluminium soleplate with non-stick PTFE or ceramic coating
Thermostatic bimetallic temperature controller with fabric selector dial
Thermal fuse fail-safe cut-off in thermal contact with soleplate
Flexible braided or rubberized power cord with swiveling strain relief
intended_use: Smoothing and pressing of domestic garments, fabrics, and household textiles

key_clauses.title: Earthing Continuity & Shock Protection
key_clauses.requirement_text: Soleplate and all accessible metallic parts must be securely bonded to earthing terminal. Earthing resistance must not exceed 0.1 ohm at 25A current.
key_clauses.test_method: High current ground bond test bench (25A AC for 60 seconds)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Ground Bond Earthing Resistance Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Soleplate Maximum Temperature and Handle Touch Safety
key_clauses.requirement_text: Soleplate temperature on linen setting must not exceed 250°C. Temperature rise of user handle grip must not exceed 30K for plastic during continuous operation.
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated contact thermocouples mounted on soleplate and handle grip
key_clauses.required_evidence: Soleplate & Handle Grip Thermal Safety Test Report

key_clauses.title: Mechanical Drop Endurance Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: The iron dropped from a height of 150 mm onto a rigid steel plate 100 times on its soleplate must not show electrical breakdown, loosening, or live part exposure.
key_clauses.test_method: Automated mechanical lift-and-drop mechanism cycling 100 times
key_clauses.required_evidence: Mechanical Soleplate Drop Endurance Test Sheet

key_clauses.title: Supply Cord Flexing Durability Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: Supply cord entry must withstand 20,000 flexing cycles under 10 N load at 90° angle without conductor wire strand rupture or jacket damage.
key_clauses.test_method: Reciprocating cord flexing machine operating at 60 flexes/minute
key_clauses.required_evidence: Power Cord Flexing Endurance Test Certificate

title: Medical Respirator - Specification
status: Current / Extremely High Medical & Public Health Relevance
characteristics: Multi-layer non-woven polypropylene composite with electrostatically charged meltblown filter
Cup-shaped, flat-fold, or duckbill construction with airtight facial contour seal
Elastic headbands (not earloops) providing >= 10 N clamping tension
Fluid splash resistance against high-pressure synthetic blood
intended_use: Respiratory barrier protection for healthcare workers against airborne pathogenic aerosols, viruses, bacteria, and droplets

key_clauses.title: Particulate Filtration Efficiency (PFE >= 95%)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Filtration efficiency against neutralizing sodium chloride (NaCl) aerosol (particle size 0.3 micron) at 95 L/min air flow must be >= 95.0% (Class FFP2/N95).
key_clauses.test_method: Automated filter tester (TSI 8130A) with photometer aerosol detection
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Certified Particulate Filtration Efficiency (PFE) Report

key_clauses.title: Bacterial Filtration Efficiency (BFE >= 98%)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Bacterial filtration efficiency tested using Staphylococcus aureus aerosol at 28.3 L/min air flow must be >= 98.0%.
key_clauses.test_method: Andersen 6-stage biological cascade impactor under EN 14683
key_clauses.required_evidence: Bacterial Filtration Efficiency (BFE) Laboratory Certificate

key_clauses.title: Total Inward Leakage (TIL) of Face Seal
key_clauses.requirement_text: Total inward leakage measured on 10 human test subjects performing standard exercises in NaCl test chamber shall not exceed 8.0% of ambient aerosol concentration.
key_clauses.test_method: Human subject test chamber with photometer probe inside mask cavity
key_clauses.required_evidence: Total Inward Leakage (TIL) Human Subject Fit Test Report

key_clauses.title: Breathing Resistance (Inhalation & Exhalation)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Inhalation airflow resistance shall not exceed 240 Pa at 95 L/min air flow; exhalation resistance shall not exceed 300 Pa at 160 L/min air flow.
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated breathing resistance test bench with differential pressure transducer
key_clauses.required_evidence: Breathing Airflow Resistance Delta-P Log Sheet

key_clauses.title: Synthetic Blood Splash Penetration Resistance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Outer surface must resist penetration of 2 ml synthetic blood discharged at a velocity corresponding to 120 mmHg (16.0 kPa) pressure without strike-through.
key_clauses.test_method: Pneumatic synthetic blood jet apparatus under ASTM F1862
key_clauses.required_evidence: Synthetic Blood Fluid Splash Penetration Test Certificate

title: Moulds for Use in Tests of Cement, Concrete and Pozzolana - Specification
status: Current / Metrology Equipment Specification
characteristics: Machined close-grained cast iron (IS 210) or carbon steel plates with precision milled joint faces
Interior faces machined plane to within 0.02 mm tolerance; angles strictly 90° ± 0.5°
Rigid detachable base plate with quick-release clamping bolts preventing slurry leakage
intended_use: Precision casting of standardized mortar, cement, and concrete test specimens for laboratory compressive and tensile testing

key_clauses.title: Material and Minimum Wall Thickness
key_clauses.requirement_text: Mould bodies shall be cast iron Grade FG 200 of IS 210 or structural steel IS 2062. Wall thickness shall not be less than 8.0 mm for 70.6 mm moulds and 12.0 mm for 150 mm moulds.
key_clauses.test_method: Ultrasonic thickness gauge and chemical spectrometry of casting
key_clauses.required_evidence: Cast Iron Metallurgical Grade & Wall Thickness Certificate

key_clauses.title: Internal Dimensions and Angle Squareness
key_clauses.requirement_text: Internal nominal distance between opposite faces shall be within ±0.15 mm. The angle between adjacent interior faces shall be 90° ± 0.5°.
key_clauses.test_method: Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) or precision dial micrometer
key_clauses.required_evidence: CMM Dimensional Metrology Calibration Sheet

key_clauses.title: Flatness and Planeness of Interior Working Faces
key_clauses.requirement_text: Each interior face shall be plane to within 0.02 mm over its entire area. Base plate top surface flatness shall not exceed 0.03 mm.
key_clauses.test_method: Optical flat / precision straightedge with 0.02 mm feeler gauge
key_clauses.required_evidence: Surface Planeness & Flatness Metrology Report

title: Ordinary Portland Cement (33, 43 and 53 Grade) - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory Cement QCO / Critical Infrastructure

amendments.summary: Mandatory QCO enforcement; strict compressive strength limits at 72 hours and autoclave soundness criteria.

characteristics: Hydraulic binder produced by pulverizing Portland clinker with calcium sulphate gypsum
Minimum 28-day compressive strength: 33 MPa (33 Grade), 43 MPa (43 Grade), 53 MPa (53 Grade)
Strict control over Lime Saturation Factor, Tricalcium Aluminate (C3A), and Magnesia content
intended_use: Reinforced concrete structures (RCC), high-rise buildings, bridges, highways, precast railway sleepers, and prestressed concrete

key_clauses.title: Chemical Composition & Mineral Ratios
key_clauses.requirement_text: Lime Saturation Factor (LSF) must be between 0.66 and 1.02. Insoluble residue max 5.0%, Magnesia (MgO) max 6.0%, Total Sulphur (SO3) max 3.5%, Loss on Ignition max 5.0%.
key_clauses.test_method: X-ray fluorescence (XRF) and wet chemical analysis conforming to IS 4032
key_clauses.required_evidence: Chemical Composition & Mineralogical Analysis Certificate

key_clauses.title: Fineness by Blaine Air Permeability Method
key_clauses.requirement_text: Specific surface area determined by Blaine air permeability apparatus shall not be less than 225 m²/kg.
key_clauses.test_method: Blaine air permeability fineness test under IS 4031 (Part 2)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Blaine Specific Surface Fineness Log

key_clauses.title: Soundness by Le-Chatelier and Autoclave Methods
key_clauses.requirement_text: Expansion by Le-Chatelier method shall not exceed 10 mm. Expansion by Autoclave method shall not exceed 0.8%.
key_clauses.test_method: Le-Chatelier water bath expansion and high-pressure steam autoclave under IS 4031 (Part 3)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Le-Chatelier & Autoclave Soundness Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Setting Time (Initial and Final)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Initial setting time shall not be less than 30 minutes; final setting time shall not be more than 600 minutes (10 hours).
key_clauses.test_method: Vicat needle penetration apparatus under IS 4031 (Part 5)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Vicat Needle Setting Time Test Sheet

key_clauses.title: Compressive Strength (72h, 168h, 672h)
key_clauses.requirement_text: For OPC 53 Grade: 72 hours strength >= 27.0 MPa; 168 hours (7 days) strength >= 37.0 MPa; 672 hours (28 days) strength >= 53.0 MPa.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard 70.6 mm mortar cube compressive load testing machine under IS 4031 (Part 6)
key_clauses.required_evidence: 28-Day Mortar Cube Compressive Strength Test Report

title: Packaged Pasteurized Milk - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory Food Safety Standard / High Public Health
characteristics: Pure bovine liquid milk subjected to High-Temperature Short-Time (HTST) pasteurization (72°C for 15s) and immediately chilled < 4°C
Guaranteed minimum milk fat and Solids-Not-Fat (SNF) percentages
Strict negative phosphatase verification and zero chemical preservatives or neutralizers
intended_use: Direct human fluid consumption, infant and maternal nutrition, tea, coffee, and culinary preparation

key_clauses.title: Milk Fat and Solids-Not-Fat (SNF) Content
key_clauses.requirement_text: Toned milk: Fat >= 3.0%, SNF >= 8.5%. Standardized milk: Fat >= 4.5%, SNF >= 8.5%. Full cream milk: Fat >= 6.0%, SNF >= 9.0%.
key_clauses.test_method: Gerber butyrometer centrifuge fat test and lactometer SNF calculation
key_clauses.required_evidence: Milk Compositional Analysis Certificate (Fat & SNF)

key_clauses.title: Alkaline Phosphatase Pasteurization Efficacy Test
key_clauses.requirement_text: Phosphatase enzyme test must be completely negative (conforming to complete inactivation of pathogenic bacteria during heat treatment).
key_clauses.test_method: Spectrophotometric p-nitrophenyl phosphate assay under IS 1479
key_clauses.required_evidence: Phosphatase Activity Negative Certificate

key_clauses.title: Microbiological Colony Limits (Total Plate & Coliform)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Total plate count shall not exceed 30,000 cfu/ml; Coliform count shall not exceed 10 cfu/ml in packaged milk at dispatch.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard agar plate incubation at 37°C under IS 5402 and IS 5401
key_clauses.required_evidence: Bacteriological Colony Count Laboratory Report

key_clauses.title: Zero Tolerance for Adulterants (Urea, Starch, Detergent, Neutralizers)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Milk must test completely negative for added chemical neutralizers (sodium hydroxide, carbonates), urea, detergent, hydrogen peroxide, and starch.
key_clauses.test_method: Chemical strip testing and chromogenic reagent assays under FSSAI / BIS methods
key_clauses.required_evidence: Adulterant-Free Comprehensive Chemical Screen Certificate

title: Portland Calcined Clay Limestone Cement - Specification
status: Current / Sustainable Low-Carbon Cement Standard
characteristics: Low carbon footprint ternary cement binder: 50% clinker, 30% calcined kaolinitic clay, 15% limestone, 5% gypsum
Reduces CO2 emissions by up to 40% compared to traditional OPC cement
Exceptional resistance to chloride penetration, sulphate attack, and alkali-silica reaction
intended_use: Sustainable concrete infrastructure, coastal and marine structures, bridges, dams, and mass residential housing

key_clauses.title: Mineral Constituent Proportions and Clay Reactivity
key_clauses.requirement_text: Portland clinker content 45% to 55%, calcined clay 25% to 35%, limestone 10% to 20%. Calcined clay reactive silica + alumina must be >= 60%.
key_clauses.test_method: Quantitative X-ray diffraction (Rietveld refinement) and chemical analysis
key_clauses.required_evidence: Constituent Mineral Phase Quantification Report

key_clauses.title: Chloride Content and Loss on Ignition
key_clauses.requirement_text: Chloride content shall not exceed 0.10% by mass. Loss on ignition (LOI) must be between 4.0% and 8.0% due to controlled limestone decarbonation.
key_clauses.test_method: Potentiometric titration and muffle furnace ignition at 950°C
key_clauses.required_evidence: Chloride & LOI Chemical Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Compressive Strength (72h, 168h, 672h)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Standard mortar cube compressive strength: 72 hours >= 16.0 MPa, 168 hours >= 27.0 MPa, 672 hours (28 days) >= 43.0 MPa.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard 70.6 mm mortar cube compressive load testing machine under IS 4031
key_clauses.required_evidence: 28-Day Compressive Strength Development Log

key_clauses.title: Resistance to Chloride Ion Penetration
key_clauses.requirement_text: Rapid Chloride Penetration Test (RCPT) charge passed at 28 days must be < 1000 Coulombs (Very Low permeability rating).
key_clauses.test_method: RCPT apparatus under ASTM C1202 / IS 516 (Part 5)
key_clauses.required_evidence: Rapid Chloride Ion Penetration (RCPT) Test Report

title: Rim Locks and Latches - Specification
status: Current / Safety & Security Hardware Relevance
characteristics: Surface-mounted lock case with bevelled spring latch bolt and square security deadbolt
Key-operated pin-tumbler cylinder from exterior with brass cylinder core
Heavy duty strike plate with reinforced anchoring for forced entry resistance
intended_use: Securing wooden and metal doors against unauthorized entry in residential and commercial premises

key_clauses.title: Material Specifications and Cylinder Pin Tumblers
key_clauses.requirement_text: Lock case shall be cold rolled mild steel sheet min 1.6 mm thick or brass casting. Key cylinder must have minimum 5 brass pin tumblers with anti-pick spool pins.
key_clauses.test_method: Metallurgical spark spectrometry and dimensional caliper verification
key_clauses.required_evidence: Material Grade & Key Cylinder Disassembly Inspection Report

key_clauses.title: Deadbolt Throw and Latch Projection
key_clauses.requirement_text: Minimum deadbolt throw shall not be less than 15.0 mm when fully engaged. Spring latch projection shall not be less than 10.0 mm.
key_clauses.test_method: Precision vernier depth gauge measuring bolt projection
key_clauses.required_evidence: Bolt Throw Dimensional Verification Certificate

key_clauses.title: Mechanical Operating Endurance (100,000 Cycles)
key_clauses.requirement_text: The lock mechanism must complete 100,000 full operating cycles of key rotation and latch retraction without spring breakage, deadbolt jamming, or key binding.
key_clauses.test_method: Automated pneumatic robotic key rotation testing fixture
key_clauses.required_evidence: 100,000 Cycle Mechanical Endurance Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Resistance to End Load Force (Forced Entry Attack)
key_clauses.requirement_text: The engaged deadbolt must withstand a static end-load force of 5000 N applied against the bolt head without collapsing into the case or shearing off.
key_clauses.test_method: Hydraulic static compression load tester applied directly to deadbolt head
key_clauses.required_evidence: 5000 N Forced Entry End-Load Attack Certificate

title: Single-Use Sterile Rubber Surgical Gloves - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory Medical Device Safety Standard
characteristics: Natural rubber latex or synthetic polyisoprene / nitrile elastomer compounded glove
Anatomically curved fingers with palm textured grip and beaded cuff
Pre-sterilized by ethylene oxide (EtO) or gamma irradiation in individual peel-open pouches
intended_use: Worn on the hands of operating personnel to prevent microbiological cross-contamination between patient and surgeon during surgical procedures

key_clauses.title: Freedom from Holes (Water Tightness Test AQL 0.65)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Gloves tested by water leak test (1000 ml water suspended for 2 minutes) must meet Acceptable Quality Limit (AQL) of 0.65 conforming to ISO 2859-1.
key_clauses.test_method: 1000 ml vertical water suspension leak test apparatus
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Certified Water Tightness AQL 0.65 Report

key_clauses.title: Tensile Strength and Ultimate Elongation (Before and After Aging)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Before aging: Tensile strength >= 24.0 MPa, Elongation >= 750%. After accelerated oven aging (70°C for 168h): Tensile strength >= 18.0 MPa, Elongation >= 560%.
key_clauses.test_method: Universal tensile testing machine with optical extensometer under ISO 37
key_clauses.required_evidence: Tensile Properties Before & After Aging Certificate

key_clauses.title: Sterility Assurance Level (SAL 10^-6)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Gloves must comply with sterility assurance level (SAL) of 10^-6 validated under ISO 11135 (EtO) or ISO 11137 (Radiation). Zero microbial growth after 14 days incubation.
key_clauses.test_method: Direct inoculation sterility test in Fluid Thioglycollate and Soybean Casein Digest media
key_clauses.required_evidence: 14-Day Sterility Validation & Biological Indicator Certificate

key_clauses.title: Biocompatibility: Dermal Irritation and Extractable Protein
key_clauses.requirement_text: Extractable protein content for latex gloves must be < 50 ug/dm². Zero primary skin irritation and sensitization under ISO 10993.
key_clauses.test_method: Modified Lowry protein assay conforming to ASTM D5712
key_clauses.required_evidence: Biocompatibility & Extractable Protein Test Report

title: Sports Footwear – Part 3 Professional Sports Footwear - Specification
status: Current / Medium Consumer Safety & High Performance
characteristics: Engineered athletic footwear with anatomical biomechanical support and rigid torsion plate
High-energy return midsole (supercritical nitrogen-infused EVA / PEBAX foam)
High-abrasion molded rubber outsole with sport-specific stud/tread pattern
intended_use: Competitive athletics, high-intensity professional sports, court games, and athletic injury reduction

key_clauses.title: Heel Energy Absorption and Impact Attenuation
key_clauses.requirement_text: Energy absorption of the heel seat under dynamic impact loading must not be less than 25.0 Joules. Peak transmitted force must not exceed 2.5 kN.
key_clauses.test_method: Dynamic impactor apparatus dropping 8.5 kg mass on heel section
key_clauses.required_evidence: Dynamic Heel Impact Attenuation Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Dynamic Sole Flexing Durability (150,000 Cycles)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Sole assembly must withstand 150,000 flexing cycles on Bennewart flexing machine at 90° angle without crack initiation exceeding 3 mm.
key_clauses.test_method: Bennewart sole flexing machine under ISO 16177
key_clauses.required_evidence: 150,000 Cycle Dynamic Sole Flexing Log

key_clauses.title: Slip Resistance and Dynamic Coefficient of Friction
key_clauses.requirement_text: Coefficient of friction on wet ceramic tile with sodium lauryl sulphate lubricant shall not be less than 0.45 (heel) and 0.40 (flat).
key_clauses.test_method: Mechanical footwear slip resistance tester under ISO 13287
key_clauses.required_evidence: NABL Footwear Slip Resistance Friction Report

key_clauses.title: Upper-to-Sole Bond Peeling Strength
key_clauses.requirement_text: Adhesion peel strength between upper and outsole shall not be less than 4.0 N/mm along the entire perimeter.
key_clauses.test_method: Tensile bond testing machine under ISO 17708
key_clauses.required_evidence: Upper-to-Sole Adhesive Peel Strength Report

title: Sports Footwear – Part 1 General Purpose - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory Footwear QCO 2024 / High Safety Relevance

amendments.summary: Mandatory Quality Control Order (QCO) enforcement by DPIIT for all general purpose sports footwear.

characteristics: General recreation sports footwear with synthetic leather, mesh textile, or leather upper
Molded polyurethane (PU), ethylene vinyl acetate (EVA), or vulcanized rubber outsole
Harmlessness compliance: zero toxic phthalates, lead, or banned aromatic azo dyes
intended_use: General fitness, walking, school sports, gym training, and everyday active recreational use

key_clauses.title: Chemical Harmlessness (Banned Azo Dyes & Heavy Metals)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Total lead content in all components must not exceed 90 mg/kg. Prohibited carcinogenic aromatic amines (azo dyes) must not exceed 30 mg/kg.
key_clauses.test_method: ICP-OES spectrometry and GC-MS gas chromatography
key_clauses.required_evidence: Chemical Harmlessness & Toxic Metal Screen Certificate

key_clauses.title: Outsole Abrasion Resistance
key_clauses.requirement_text: Relative volume loss of outsole material under abrasive friction shall not exceed 250 mm³ for density <= 0.9 g/cm³ on DIN rotary drum.
key_clauses.test_method: DIN rotary drum abrader under ISO 4649
key_clauses.required_evidence: Sole Abrasion Volume Loss Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Outsole Flexing Resistance (50,000 Cycles)
key_clauses.requirement_text: After 50,000 continuous flex cycles on Ross flexing machine, crack growth shall not exceed 4.0 mm.
key_clauses.test_method: Ross flex tester cycling at 100 flexes per minute under ISO 5423
key_clauses.required_evidence: Ross Outsole Flexing Endurance Test Sheet

key_clauses.title: Upper-to-Sole Adhesion Bond Strength
key_clauses.requirement_text: Minimum peeling strength between upper and sole must not be less than 3.0 N/mm.
key_clauses.test_method: Tensile bond testing machine under ISO 17708
key_clauses.required_evidence: Adhesion Peeling Strength Test Report

title: Soluble Coffee Powder - Specification
status: Current / High Food Safety Relevance
characteristics: Free-flowing brown powder or agglomerated granules obtained exclusively by aqueous extraction of roasted coffee beans
100% pure coffee solids without added chicory, starch, or artificial flavors
Immediate full solubility in hot water without residue
intended_use: Instant beverage preparation by dissolution in hot or cold water or milk

key_clauses.title: Moisture Content Limits
key_clauses.requirement_text: Moisture content shall not exceed 4.0% by mass for spray-dried coffee and 5.0% by mass for freeze-dried coffee granules.
key_clauses.test_method: Vacuum oven drying at 70°C conforming to IS 2791
key_clauses.required_evidence: Moisture Content Gravimetric Analysis Report

key_clauses.title: Total Caffeine Content on Dry Basis
key_clauses.requirement_text: Total caffeine content on dry matter basis shall not be less than 2.8% by mass for pure soluble coffee.
key_clauses.test_method: High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) / Spectrophotometric method
key_clauses.required_evidence: HPLC Caffeine Content Assay Certificate

key_clauses.title: Total Ash and Acid-Insoluble Ash
key_clauses.requirement_text: Total ash shall be between 7.0% and 14.0% by mass on dry basis. Acid-insoluble ash must not exceed 0.1% by mass.
key_clauses.test_method: Muffle furnace incineration at 550°C and hydrochloric acid digestion
key_clauses.required_evidence: Total Ash & Acid Insoluble Ash Report

key_clauses.title: Solubility Rate in Hot and Cold Water
key_clauses.requirement_text: Must dissolve completely in boiling water within 30 seconds with moderate stirring, and in cold water (20°C) within 3 minutes without leaving insoluble sediment.
key_clauses.test_method: Standard volumetric dissolution visual inspection test
key_clauses.required_evidence: Solubility Dissolution Rate Observation Sheet

key_clauses.title: Toxic Metal Contaminant Thresholds (Lead, Arsenic, Copper)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Lead shall not exceed 0.5 mg/kg, Arsenic max 0.2 mg/kg, Copper max 30.0 mg/kg.
key_clauses.test_method: Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometry (AAS) under FSSAI methods
key_clauses.required_evidence: Heavy Metal Trace Purity Certificate

title: Switched Socket-Outlets without Interlock for Fixed Installations - Specification
status: Current / Mandatory Electrical QCO 2023 / Very High Safety

amendments.summary: Mandatory Electrical Accessories QCO order. Automatic safety shutter verification made mandatory.

characteristics: Modular combined 1-way rocker switch and 3-pin shuttered socket unit
Rated voltage up to 250V AC, current 6A / 16A, for domestic fixed wiring
Flame-retardant virgin polycarbonate molding with phosphor bronze contacts
Automatic safety shutters over live and neutral socket apertures
intended_use: Fixed domestic and commercial electrical installations for safe plugging of appliances

key_clauses.title: Safety Child-Proof Shutters Operation
key_clauses.requirement_text: Live and neutral socket apertures must be automatically blocked by internal shutters. Shutters must not open when 1.0 mm probe is inserted under 20 N force, opening only upon simultaneous earthing pin entry.
key_clauses.test_method: Calibrated 1.0 mm steel probe insertion test under 20 N load
key_clauses.required_evidence: Safety Shutter Child Ingress Protection Report

key_clauses.title: Plug Withdrawal Force Limits
key_clauses.requirement_text: Withdrawal force for removing test plug from 16A socket must not be less than 5.0 N (preventing loose arcing contact) and not more than 54.0 N.
key_clauses.test_method: Precision tensile force gauge measuring plug separation force
key_clauses.required_evidence: Plug Withdrawal Retention Force Calibration Report

key_clauses.title: Temperature Rise Under 1.1x Rated Current
key_clauses.requirement_text: Terminals and contacts carrying 1.1 times rated current (17.6 A for 16A socket) continuously for 1 hour must not exhibit temperature rise exceeding 45K.
key_clauses.test_method: Thermocouple temperature data logger during current injection
key_clauses.required_evidence: Current Overload Temperature Rise Test Report

key_clauses.title: Resistance to Abnormal Heat and Fire (Glow-Wire 850°C)
key_clauses.requirement_text: Insulating material holding current-carrying parts must withstand glow-wire test at 850°C with flames extinguishing within 30 seconds of removal.
key_clauses.test_method: Glow-wire test apparatus under IEC 60695-2-11
key_clauses.required_evidence: 850°C Glow-Wire Flammability Test Certificate

title: Titanium Dioxide for Pigmentary Applications - Specification
status: Current / Industrial Quality Relevance
characteristics: Synthetic inorganic white pigment available in Rutile (Type R) or Anatase (Type A) crystal forms
Alumina, silica, or zirconia inorganic surface treatment for weatherability
High refractive index, exceptional opacity, and tinting strength
intended_use: White opacifying pigment in architectural paints, industrial coatings, plastics, printing inks, and paper

key_clauses.title: Titanium Dioxide (TiO2) Purity Content
key_clauses.requirement_text: Titanium dioxide content shall not be less than 92.0% by mass for Rutile pigment and 98.0% by mass for untreated Anatase pigment.
key_clauses.test_method: Aluminium reduction titrimetric method conforming to IS 411
key_clauses.required_evidence: TiO2 Chemical Purity Titration Analysis Report

key_clauses.title: Volatile Matter at 105°C and Moisture
key_clauses.requirement_text: Loss on drying at 105°C for 2 hours shall not exceed 0.5% by mass.
key_clauses.test_method: Gravimetric drying oven test under IS 33
key_clauses.required_evidence: Volatile Matter Gravimetric Loss Sheet

key_clauses.title: Water Soluble Matter and pH of Aqueous Suspension
key_clauses.requirement_text: Matter soluble in water shall not exceed 0.5% by mass. pH of 10% aqueous suspension shall be within 6.5 to 8.5.
key_clauses.test_method: Conductivity cell and calibrated pH meter
key_clauses.required_evidence: Water Soluble Salts & pH Test Certificate

key_clauses.title: Oil Absorption and Relative Tinting Strength
key_clauses.requirement_text: Oil absorption value shall be between 16 and 26 g per 100 g pigment. Relative tinting strength shall not be less than 100% of reference standard.
key_clauses.test_method: Spatula rub-out oil absorption method with refined linseed oil
key_clauses.required_evidence: Oil Absorption & Tinting Strength Test Report
